responsibility: Implements the GNU Modula-2 wrapper layer over POSIX termios terminal control. It allocates and frees struct termios objects, wraps baud-rate and tc* attribute/flow/flush operations, exports constants such as TCSANOW/TCSAFLUSH, and provides large switch-based accessors that map Modula-2 enum values onto host termios flag bits and control-character slots, returning success/failure when a particular host feature is or is not available.
